3967-6553-8207.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

215-4742-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-4742-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

141-2921-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-3249-3621-4289.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3621-4289.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

2033-2092-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2033-2092-4687.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
2033-2092-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6772-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

1496-1594-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-1594-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2469-5220-6794-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1806-4871-5231-7499.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {R}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/G}.
Activate Lluwen by exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, causing Lluwen to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Pest Friend by paying {B/G}, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Pest, adding {R}.
When the Pest dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2438-4986-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
2438-4986-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

2292-2301-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2292-2301-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2781-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm either from your hand or graveyard by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Felidar Guardian and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters, Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
2781-4605-7260.notes: If Nature's Rhythm is in your hand, {G}{G} is removed from the cost. However, if it's in your graveyard, you can tap a creature to also reduce the cost.

372-673-7095.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-673-7095.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Chakra Meditation and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Chakra Meditation's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Chakra Meditation trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Chakra Meditation and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2604-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

437-3525-6723.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

640-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

586-1796-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3622-4067-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
3622-4067-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gravedigger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Gravedigger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Gravedigger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

1812-3525-4131-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

1525-2031-2406-2660-3122.notablePrerequisites:
Undercover Operative is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3122.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3122.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Fiend Hunter

372-1734-4753.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Clever Impersonator until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Clever Impersonator from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Fiend Hunter.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-3410-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {U/B}.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw Memnite from the top of your library.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1742-1797-4050-5003.notablePrerequisites: At least two creatures have died this turn.
1742-1797-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Inga, adding {1}.
When Inga dies, it's second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Inga trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar three times by discarding three cards, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Inga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Inga enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to scry 3.
Repeat.

1636-2292-2527-3784-4170.notablePrerequisites: Fain and Vhal do not have summoning sickness.
1636-2292-2527-3784-4170.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Vhal triggers, giving creatures that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
Viscera Seer dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Viscera Seer enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from Viscera Seer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to get infinite Inklings, and thus infinite +1/+1 counters via Fain.

1778-2292-2823-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Memnite.
Memnite dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Memnite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1 and put Memnite on the bottom of your library.
The Temporal Anchor triggers, exiling Memnite from the bottom of your library.
Cast Memnite from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1283-3525-3586.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Magus Lucea Kane.
Magus Lucea Kane does not have summoning sickness.
1283-3525-3586.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
You may then cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its mana cost, getting infinite copies of that spell or ability.

1371-3189-4510.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
Ashiok has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1371-3189-4510.description:
Activate Ashiok by removing a loyalty counter from it, causing target player to mill four cards and exiling each opponent's graveyard.
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Doomsday.
Resolve an opponent's Doomsday, causing them to exile their library and not search for any cards due to Ashiok, and lose half their life total, rounded up.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining opponent.
Resolve your Doomsday, searching your library and/or graveyard for five cards, exiling the rest of your library and graveyard, and putting the five chosen cards on top of your library in any order, and losing half your life total, rounded up.

147-223-1817.notablePrerequisites:
Kalamax is tapped.
You have not cast another instant this turn.
147-223-1817.description:
Cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major targeting Dualcaster Mage by paying {U}{G}.
Kalamax triggers, copying the Double Major, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copied Double Major, resolving a copy of Dualcaster Mage.
The Dualcaster Mage copy enters, copying Double Major, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 4.

262-3957-4506.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-3957-4506.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Auriok Champion three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
